action.layout_note: piperx has 7 arm/gripper controls; runtime.action_layout is authoritative.

reset.variation: none; seed is provenance only, not a reset randomization input

spec: ball size, mass, friction and pickup pose
rail family, fixed anchors, spacing, radius, 160 segments per rail
episode_instance: initial_state (identical fixed reset state for all 15 attempts)
policy_decision: release position chosen through robot actions
derived: Hermite curve and compiled collision model from resolved track parameters

rules.grasp: both active-arm fingers contact for >=0.1 s at control ticks; lift while both touch until ball center z>0.735 m
rules.release: no gripper contact for >=0.06 s at physics substeps; record first uninterrupted separation position/velocity
rules.legal_release: open requested AND min distance to 250 uniformly sampled track.ball_position(x, clearance=0), x in [0.32,0.57], <=0.035 m AND linear speed<=0.45 m/s
rules.route: after release: rail contact with 0.64<x<0.73; then contact one of last 3 rail segments; then no rail contact >=0.008 s and center x>0.875; separation-start vx>0 AND vz>0
rules.inside_cup: relative to the resolved cup pose (x=1.10, y=-0.18, base_height_m): -0.008<z<0.153 AND hypot(x,y)<0.033 (small contact/measurement tolerance)
rules.success: released AND inside_cup AND no gripper contact AND speed<0.12 m/s continuously >=0.3 s at 50 Hz, with no failure; route milestones are recorded when detected but are not required for the terminal occupancy check
rules.completion_event: ball_settled_in_cup only; milestones never count as completion
failure_checks: gripper contact after confirmed release => ball_touched_after_release
confirmed separation with vx<=0 or vz<=0 => invalid_exit
rail contact after confirmed launch => rail_contact_after_launch
ball center z<0.035 => missed_cup or bounced_out
released AND outside cup AND no gripper contact AND speed<0.04 m/s continuously >=1 s => stalled_on_rail or settled_outside_cup
rules.nonfinite: native environment reports non_finite_state; unified replay marks run invalid and aborts the group, not a zero-score model failure
rules.score: 100 on terminal success; otherwise 0; reward=1 on success, otherwise 0
rules.failure_priority: failure blocks success at the same control tick
rules.horizon: 3000 control steps = 60 simulated seconds; timeout without terminal result is truncation and score 0
rules.feasibility: existing independent 25-position physical scan must demonstrate a launch and cup success or generation fails; no automatic replacement seed; not a robot-path certificate
